notes: The compatibility matrix. Rules are evaluated against a candidate plan (game profile + translator variant + version + loader version). `severity: block` removes the candidate, `warn` keeps it with a note, `info` only annotates, `prefer` shifts the score. Every rule carries `confidence` and `sources`; the CLI and UI show unverified rules as advisories, never as hard blocks.

rules.message: This game uses the IL2CPP scripting backend (GameAssembly.dll). Mono-targeted packages cannot load. Use the BepInEx-IL2CPP or MelonMod-IL2CPP package instead.
This game uses the Mono scripting backend (MonoBleedingEdge / Managed assemblies). The IL2CPP package will not load here.
BepInEx 5 does not support IL2CPP games ('Games built with IL2CPP are not supported at the moment'). BepInEx 6 IL2CPP bleeding-edge builds are required.
XUnity.AutoTranslator 5.4.0+ was built against BepInEx bleeding-edge build 704 ('Update to BepInEx 6.0 BE-704 to fix some IL2CPP crashes'). Older BE builds are known to crash under IL2CPP.
XUnity.AutoTranslator 5.3.0 dropped support for pre-2017 Unity versions in its IL2CPP packages. For a pre-2017 IL2CPP build, an out-of-process OCR translator is the realistic option.
Release v5.6 does not publish a ReiPatcher asset. Pin 5.6.1 (or 5.5.2) when the ReiPatcher variant is required.
DeepL API authentication moved to the Authorization header in 5.5.2. Earlier versions send the legacy query/body auth and will fail against the current DeepL API.

This game ships Unity's new Input System. XUnity.AutoTranslator 5.5.1 switched to UnityInput to support both input stacks; on older versions the in-game hotkeys (ALT+0 config UI, ALT+T retranslate) typically do nothing.
A mod loader is already installed in this game folder. The README warns ReiPatcher 'is incompatible with other plugin managers installed'. Use the package matching the loader that is already there.
rules.note: This list is the one the resolver reads. The same conflict is also described prose-style in translators.json (variant.constraints.conflictsWithInstalled) and loaders.json (constraints.conflictsWith); those are documentation and are not evaluated.

rules.message: Loader architecture must match the game executable: x86 build for a 32-bit game, x64 for a 64-bit game. IndieDeck reads the PE header of the launch executable to decide.
MelonLoader on IL2CPP requires the .NET 6.0 Desktop Runtime. The Windows installer pulls it automatically; a manual zip install may not.
MelonLoader is commonly cited as requiring Unity 5.6.1 or newer, but upstream docs do not state a range. Treat this as advisory: if the game is older, prefer BepInEx 5 (documented down to Unity 3).
For Unity older than 5.3, the legacy texture-loading path in AutoTranslatorConfig.ini is often required for image translation to work.

TextMeshPro cannot render Korean/Japanese/Chinese glyphs with the game's built-in font atlas - translated text shows as blank boxes. Install a TMP fallback font bundle matching the game's Unity version and set FallbackFontTextMeshPro.
Old Mono runtimes have TLS 1.2 problems that can lock up translation requests. If translation stalls with no errors, try a different endpoint or the ReiPatcher variant.
No maintained in-process text translator exists for this engine. Screen OCR (MORT) or a hook/OCR hybrid (LunaTranslator) is the practical route.
This Ren'Py build ships only .rpa archives / .rpyc bytecode. Offline translators need decompiled .rpy sources - unpack first (UnRen or rpatool), or use screen OCR instead.
Bleeding-edge loader builds are unsigned CI artifacts and can regress between builds; they are only chosen when nothing stable satisfies the requirements.
Reuses the loader already present in the game folder instead of stacking a second one.
